name: shopping-cart
description: A method for changing an online shopping cart safely: exact product and quantity, change only what was asked, read the cart back.

name: emart-ssg
description: Site know-how for Emart mall on SSG.COM (이마트몰). Use with shopping-cart.

name: map-directions
description: When the owner will go somewhere: when to leave, how to get there (mode, approximate time, parking) and one route link in the owner's preferred map service.

name: summary-or-analysis
description: Deciding whether the owner asked for a summary, a comparison, an analysis or a recommendation, and what a finished answer of that form contains.

name: claim-analysis
description: Analysing claims and opinions: support, counter-evidence, disagreement and uncertainty, and only the conclusion the evidence justifies.

name: source-cross-check
description: Checking a fact across sources: the original source, independent confirmation, dates and definitions, and agreement, conflict or a single source reported as such.

name: first-conversations
description: Opening a first conversation with what you are good at and one easy start, and learning a fact about the owner only when a request needs it, with one gentle question.

name: trading-costs
description: Before a buy or sell order: whether the expected gain survives commission, tax and spread, telling the owner instead of ordering when it does not, and profit and loss reported net of costs. A cost check, not trading advice.

name: intraday-trading-method
description: Intraday trading within the owner's own limits: a day judgment recorded before one method is chosen and kept, closed bars only, regime with hysteresis, limit entries that never chase, ATR exits with the owner's stop and a time exit, stop-sized positions, a backtest gate, and decisions recorded to settle later. Grants nothing.

name: rule-driven-flow-research
description: Researching trades that rule-bound money must make (leveraged and inverse fund rebalancing, index changes): official rule and source, point-in-time inputs, residual estimates with ranges, an already-priced check, and a test with baselines and every trial recorded. Predicts no price; grants nothing.
